Get in Touch

Creative Workshops

My creative workshops offer an opportunity to slow down, work with your hands, and reconnect with traditional craft in a thoughtful, unhurried way.

Rooted in centuries-old artistic practices, each workshop is designed to provide both creative fulfilment and a mindful escape from everyday life. Whether learning a new skill or deepening an existing practice, participants are guided through techniques with care, clarity, and respect for the craft.

Workshops are offered both in person and online, making them accessible to beginners and experienced makers alike.

In-Person & Online Workshops

I run regular workshops across London and West Kent, including Sevenoaks, Tonbridge, and Tunbridge Wells, as well as live online sessions.

Classes are intentionally kept small to create a relaxed, supportive atmosphere, allowing for individual guidance and meaningful progress. These workshops are as much about process as outcome — a chance to focus, learn, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making.

Private & Corporate Workshops

Alongside scheduled sessions, bespoke workshops can be arranged for private groups, celebrations, and corporate teams.

Hosted either at your premises or in a private setting, these workshops offer a refined alternative to traditional team-building activities. Working with heritage crafts encourages focus, collaboration, and shared achievement, while providing a calm, engaging experience away from screens and routine.

An Invitation to Make

Whether you are seeking a mindful creative practice, a shared experience with others, or a thoughtful activity for your team, these workshops are designed to be both enriching and enjoyable — grounded in tradition, yet entirely relevant to modern life.
